events.title: Racketeering Tech Demo — Now Playable!
events.summary: The Racketeering Tech Demo is now live! This is an early look at Racketeering, so expect bugs, rough edges, and performance issues. We wanted to give you a chance to experience our vision for the game and help test its growing systems, including multiplayer, jobs, driving, and more.We’ll continue adding updates and content to the demo. events.title: RACKETEERING — DEVELOPMENT BLOG #2
events.summary: In July, our first development blog introduced the foundations of Racketeering: physical items, cultivation, processing, vehicles, a growing world and the ambition to make it all work in co-op. Over August and September, we've been joining those pieces together. This update is about what has changed and what those systems now let us build. events.title: RACKETEERING — DEVELOPMENT BLOG #1
events.summary: WELCOME TO RACKETEERINGWelcome to the first official Racketeering development blog! Forgive me in advance as this is an info dump.We’ve been hard at work building the foundations of the game, and we’re excited to finally start sharing more of that work with you. This first update is a look at what Racketeering is, what’s already taking shape, and the features we’ll be focusing on next.Development is ongoing, so everything shown and discussed may continue to change as we test, improve, and expand
